    "detail":  "Task id: fix-stale-search-results-race-in-handlebrowserqu-c50b
Title: Fix stale search results race in handleBrowserQuery
Description:
meridian.js handleBrowserQuery() has no ordering guard. Typing "a" then "ab" fires two concurrent search() calls; whichever resolves last wins, so results for a stale query can overwrite the newer ones. The existing browserSearchActive flag only tracks whether search is active, not which query is current.

Fix: capture a monotonically increasing sequence id (or the exact query string) at call time and bail out of renderSearchResults if it is no longer the latest before rendering. Verify by throttling network/CPU and typing quickly that only the final query's results render.

Report progress and completion through POST http://localhost:9807/agent/report with task_id "fix-stale-search-results-race-in-handlebrowserqu-c50b". Do not edit .tasker/tasks files or change task status directly."
}

item.text: The search flow has two asynchronous boundaries (`search()` and settings lookup), so I’ve tied each invocation to a sequence captured before either await. Only the invocation still matching the latest sequence can update stored results or render.
